fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC is the world's largest semiconductor foundry with 73% pure foundry market share, and a $10,000 investment five years ago has grown to over $38,000 today.
fields.summary_ko.1: In the Foundry 2.0 market (including advanced packaging and testing), TSMC recorded 42% market share in Q2, and IDC projects this market will grow to $360B in 2026 and reach nearly $550B by 2030 at 11% CAGR.
fields.summary_ko.2: TSMC expects demand for advanced nodes for AI applications to increase at 50% CAGR through 2029, with long-term addressing opportunities expected to expand.
